# /fc:loop

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/loop.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/loop.md instead. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:loop` |
| Codex name | `$fc-loop` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/loop.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Run every unticked step of a plan until done, independent steps in parallel, then one review |
| Arguments | `<plan ID or path> [--max-parallel 1-8] [--step-timeout <minutes>]` |

## Usage

`/fc:loop` is the opt-in exception to one step per [`/fc:run`](run.md). One invocation implements
every unticked step of one plan, then runs [`/fc:review`](review.md) once. `node ai-factory/make/loop.js`
makes every decision: selection, validation, scheduling, worktrees, apply-back, ticking, stop causes,
the report and the exit code. The session only starts implementers and passes their results on.

- **Plan.** Name it by ID or path. The whole plan is validated before any step starts. A step with
  `Depends on: N, M` waits for those steps; a step without that line waits for every earlier step.
- **`--max-parallel 1-8`** (default 3). Ready steps run concurrently, each in a git worktree under
  `ai-factory/runs/tmp/worktrees/`. A step running alone runs in the main tree.
- **`--step-timeout <minutes>`** (1–240, default 30). A step running longer is stopped and recorded
  as a timeout.
- **Codex.** Steps run one at a time, and the step timeout is not enforced.

Test, lint and typecheck tools must exclude `ai-factory/runs/tmp/worktrees/`, because each worktree
holds a full copy of the repository. Headless, `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk ai TASK=loop INPUT="…"`
runs it; see [Headless runs and CI](../headless-ci.md#taskloop-exit-codes) for its exit codes.

To follow a running loop, use [`/fc:watch`](watch.md) for one snapshot, or `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk loop-watch FOLLOW=1` in a second terminal.

See also: [workflow.md: the rules that make it work](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#the-rules-that-make-it-work).

## Examples

```
/fc:loop 0022
/fc:loop ai-factory/plans/PMB-003-csv-export.md --max-parallel 2
/fc:loop ai-factory/plans/PMB-003-csv-export.md --step-timeout 45
```

## Writes

- Source and test files for each step, applied back to your tree uncommitted.
- Each step it completes, ticked in the plan.
- Temporary worktrees under `ai-factory/runs/tmp/worktrees/` and loop state under
  `ai-factory/runs/tmp/loop/<loop id>/`. Its only commits sit on its own temporary `fc-loop/…`
  branches in those worktrees.
- With artifact contracts enabled, each step's evidence. A main-tree step's implementer records it
  as under `/fc:run`; for a worktree step the helper records it in the main tree after the apply,
  and ticks the step only when that passes.

It never commits on your branch.

## Refuses or asks

- With no plan, it lists the candidate plans, implements nothing and stops.
- An unknown option or a value out of range is a usage error (exit 2). An invalid plan, such as a
  missing `Depends on:` reference, a cycle or a withdrawn step left unticked, is reported in full
  (exit 3). It asks you to reconcile the plan and stops.
- It stops on a failed step, a timeout, a conflict or refused apply when a worktree step's work is
  brought back, or a worktree that could not be prepared. Running steps finish and nothing new
  starts. It still runs the one review, then ends with the helper's report. While the review gate is
  enforced, a verdict that is not an approval is a stop cause too.
- It never pushes, opens an MR, resets, checks out, stashes or cleans your tree. It never removes a
  kept worktree and never runs `/fc:test` or `/fc:report`.
- Headless, it asks nothing: where it would ask, it reports, ends the loop and stops.
- After a stop, resume one step at a time with `/fc:run`, or with `/fc:continue <delivery id>`. Kept
  worktrees are yours to inspect and remove.
